name: world agent-pass jwks
note: Shape of https://auth.world.org/.well-known/jwks.json (discovery jwks_uri) as the client parses it: RSA, RS256, use sig, one key today with the kid shown (observed 2026-11-05; the modulus is elided — the live key is fetched, never pinned). The client caches keys by kid and refetches once on an unknown kid (rotation). services/api/src/world-agent-pass.ts LocalIdp serves this shape with a generated 2048-bit key for the local simulator and the tests.
